spec_architectural_decisions.decision: Resolve each colliding wire value by RENUMBERING the duplicate side to free codes INV-BE-134..139, keeping the established side at its original value. Constant NAMES are unchanged, so every emit/usage site automatically gets the new value — zero usage-site edits.
spec_architectural_decisions.reason: Six INV-BE values were each assigned to two different constants (090..094: BackendTranslationWarmup* vs BackendTranslation*; 110: FieldMappingDbUnavailable vs LeadIntakeInternalAuthInvalid). A client switching on the wire code could not distinguish two unrelated failures. Renumbering the duplicate side (Warmup 090-094 -> 134-138; FieldMappingDbUnavailable 110 -> 139) restores uniqueness while keeping the Translation 090-095 block and the LIW wa-direct internal-auth 110 at their values. Q decision 2026-06-14.
spec_architectural_decisions.codex_note: EXPECTED: value-only renumber, NOT a breaking API change. Constant identifiers (BackendTranslationWarmupInvalidPayload, FieldMappingDbUnavailable, ...) are byte-identical; consumers reference the constant, not the literal. Full-solution build PASS. SPA does not switch on these literals (grep-verified empty).
